| Country | 2022 infant‑mortality rate (per 1 000 live births) | 2022 current health‑expenditure per capita (current US$) | Source |
|---------|---------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------|--------|

   Using the World Bank indicator for current health expenditure per capita, `SH.XPD.CHEX.PC.CD`, the 2022 values are shown.
